articles.title: GET MORE FROM GPU ACCELERATORS WITH AMD EPYC SERVER CPUS
articles.summary: AMD EPYC™ 9006 SP7 Server CPUs [4] help maximize GPU utilization and token generation. With frequencies up to 5.3GHz, these CPUs offer the highest performance per core for server CPUs. An industry-leading PCIe® Gen 6 I/O subsystem maximizes CPU-GPU communication with 2x bandwidth per lane versus the previous generation. Up to 1.6 TB/s per-socket memory bandwidth with MRDIMM-12800 supports large-context agentic AI reasoning.

SPACEX CATCHES SHIP 42 ON FLIGHT 15, BUT BOOSTER 22 ABORTS ITS CATCH ON A LOW-FUEL-MASS ALARM DURING BOOSTBACK
articles.summary: After 14 orbits, Ship 42 made a 10-second single-engine deorbit burn and was caught by the tower's chopsticks 22.5 hours after launch, the first upper-stage catch. It deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites and had its heat shield checked using satellite cameras. The V3 booster's boostback ended early on a low-fuel-mass alarm, so guidance detected it was off-position and diverted to a Gulf splashdown, with the root cause still under investigation.

articles.title: A PETITION BACKED BY MUSK, REPLIT'S MASAD, AND EPIC'S SWEENEY ASKS NVIDIA TO REINSTATE JENSEN HUANG DURING THE INVESTIGATION
articles.summary: The petition says it has over 115,000 signatures, including 5,965 current Nvidia employees and 63,063 shareholders, and argues Huang was removed without due process, asking the board to restore him while an independent investigation establishes the facts. Huang resigned Thursday after admitting a relationship with an executive US intelligence suspects of spying for China. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Nvidia fell 2% on Friday.

articles.title: TESLA OPENS CYBERCAB PRE-ORDERS TO SELECT CUSTOMERS AT $29,990 PLUS $299 PER MONTH, GEOFENCED TO ROBOTAXI'S AREAS
articles.summary: Tesla says the Cybercab will run unsupervised only inside the same geofences as its Robotaxi service, with delivery limited to a handful of Texas cities and an estimated date of December. Musk called the $299 monthly fee too high, saying it should match the roughly $115 per month for FSD and connectivity, and that nationwide availability depends on regulatory approval.

articles.title: RESEARCHERS MATCHED THE RANDOM STARTING WEIGHTS OF CHINESE AI MODELS TO GPU THREAD LAYOUTS TO SHOW SIX TRAINED ON BLACKWELL
articles.summary: PyTorch seeds a model's weights with random numbers split across 2,048 threads per SM, so each chip lays them out differently: 132 SMs for Hopper, 148 for B200/B300, 152 for GB200/GB300. Rows untouched by training still hold those starting values, so the team searched seed and layout combinations, checked hits on held-out weights, and reproduced them on real chips. DeepSeek-V4, Kimi K3, MiniMax-M3, and Ling-3.1-flash matched Blackwell, while earlier models matched Hopper.

articles.summary: Ads get ignored on social media but not in TLDR! Reach hardware engineers and makers where they actually pay attention. Learn more about sponsorship opportunities [9].

articles.title: REINS HARNESS LETS FRONTIER MODELS RUN A DUAL-ARM ROBOT ZERO-SHOT
articles.summary: Reins wraps a frontier model in a harness that controls a dual-arm robot. The model gets 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip, and chains several per call, each gated on a condition that halts the chain at the first failure. A second “narrator” instance watches the cameras and reports what changed. With no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeded in 88% of real episodes, but without the harness it failed every shell game and took 8x longer.

articles.title: DEPLOYMENT SPEED, NOT UNIT ENERGY COST, DECIDES THE BEST WAY TO POWER AI DATA CENTERS
articles.summary: Researchers compared grid power, AC- and DC-coupled solar-plus-storage, and islanded natural gas for AI data centers, adding a speed-adjusted cost of energy that prices the compute lost to slow construction. DC coupling cuts lifetime energy costs by 18% by eliminating inverters. DC microgrids are rarely the cheapest per kWh, but they build fastest, so they come out lowest-cost in 85% of locations, or 55% if gas turbine timelines improve.

articles.title: ULA'S VULCAN LOSES 40 AMAZON LEO SATELLITES ABOUT 10 MINUTES IN, WITH CENTAUR'S BURN THE SUSPECT
articles.summary: This was ULA's first total failure since 2006 and the first Vulcan flight in nine months after its solid booster nozzle fixes. The BE-4s had been retrofitted for the oxygen valve issue behind New Glenn's May pad explosion.

articles.title: OPENAI RESTRUCTURES ITS STANDALONE ROBOTICS TEAM AFTER GENERAL MODELS LIKE GPT-6 ASTRA START RUNNING ROBOTS DIRECTLY
articles.summary: OpenAI moved its robotics researchers into its main research org and its applied robotics and hardware teams into Applied, betting general models can control robots without specialized “robot brains.” OpenAI still plans its own humanoid, with a demo targeted for 2027, while robotics startups argue real-world deployment data remains their edge.

articles.title: ROCKET LAB'S 100TH ELECTRON LAUNCH DEPLOYS IQPS'S YAMATSUMI-II RADAR SATELLITE TO A 575 KM ORBIT
articles.summary: Electron, the carbon-composite rocket with 3D-printed engines, flew its 100th mission from New Zealand, which Rocket Lab says is the fastest any commercially developed rocket has reached that count since its first launch in 2017.

articles.title: APPLIED MATERIALS' SYSTEMS REVENUE JUMPS 64% TO $7.99B AS CHIPMAKERS EXPAND FABS, WITH A $5B EPIC CENTER FOR SHARED R&D
articles.summary: Total revenue rose 53% to $10.41 billion, with the semiconductor systems unit up from $4.88 billion to $7.99 billion.

articles.title: JUDGE KEEPS DRAM PRICE-FIXING SUIT ALIVE, CALLING THE CHIPMAKERS' ALLEGED BEHAVIOR “HAWKS FLYING IN FORMATION”
articles.summary: A federal judge denied Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron's motion to dismiss in full, finding a plausible claim that they restricted conventional DRAM supply and drove prices up 697% over 18 months.

articles.title: A COPPER-TO-FIBER UPGRADE AT A REMOTE SITE CAUSED A ROUTER TO OVERLOAD FAA'S NETWORK, GROUNDING US FLIGHTS
articles.summary: Officials say an L3Harris upgrade of copper wire to fiber optic cable left a router overloading a critical communication system, grounding thousands of US flights.
